name: command
title: Command
description: Searchable command palette and modal dialog built on ui-sdk Command with a dialog.
docs: Compose CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandSeparator and CommandShortcut inside Command or CommandDialog. Use keywords on CommandItem to match synonyms without changing the visible label.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Command as SdkCommand, type CommandValueChangeDetails } from '@ui-sdk/vue/command'
import {
  containsCommandText,
  matchesCommandItem,
  provideCommandContext,
  type CommandItemMeta,
} from './context'
import { useCommandSelection } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type CommandProps = {
  filterDisabled?: boolean
  loop?: boolean
  multiple?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  defaultValue?: string | string[]
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<CommandProps>(), {
  filterDisabled: false,
  loop: true,
  multiple: false,
  disabled: false,
  defaultValue: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string | string[]>()
const searchTerm = defineModel<string>('searchTerm', { default: '' })

const items = reactive(new Map<string, CommandItemMeta>())

const filterDisabled = computed(() => props.filterDisabled)
const disabled = computed(() => props.disabled)
const multiple = computed(() => props.multiple)

const visibleIds = computed(() => {
  const set = new Set<string>()
  const query = searchTerm.value.trim()
  for (const [id, meta] of items) {
    if (
      props.filterDisabled ||
      query === '' ||
      matchesCommandItem(meta.value, meta.keywords, query, containsCommandText)
    ) {
      set.add(id)
    }
  }
  return set
})

const visibleChoices = computed(() =>
  [...visibleIds.value].flatMap((id) => {
    const item = items.get(id)
    return item && !item.disabled ? [item.value] : []
  }),
)
const selection = useCommandSelection(model, multiple, disabled, visibleChoices, props.defaultValue)

function onHighlight(value: string | null, details: CommandValueChangeDetails) {
  if (value !== null && details.reason === 'list-navigation' && details.event?.shiftKey) {
    selection.extend(value)
  }
}

provideCommandContext({
  search: searchTerm,
  disabled,
  multiple,
  isSelected: selection.isSelected,
  select: selection.select,
  filterDisabled,
  visibleIds,
  registerItem: (id, meta) => {
    items.set(id, meta)
  },
  unregisterItem: (id) => {
    items.delete(id)
  },
  matches: (value, keywords) => {
    if (props.filterDisabled) return true
    return matchesCommandItem(value, keywords, searchTerm.value, containsCommandText)
  },
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkCommand
    v-model:query="searchTerm"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :loop="loop"
    :filter="() => true"
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex h-full w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised text-ink',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
    @value-change="onHighlight"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkCommand>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from '../dialog'
import Command from './Command.vue'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type CommandDialogProps = {
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  title?: string
  description?: string
  closeOnEsc?: boolean
  closeOnOutside?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<CommandDialogProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  title: 'Command menu',
  description: 'Search for a command to run.',
  closeOnEsc: true,
  closeOnOutside: true,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>('open', { default: undefined })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog
    v-model:open="open"
    :default-open="defaultOpen"
    :close-on-esc="closeOnEsc"
    :close-on-outside="closeOnOutside"
  >
    <DialogContent
      v-bind="forwarded"
      hide-close
      :class="cn('overflow-hidden p-0', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
    >
      <DialogTitle class="sr-only">{{ title }}</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription class="sr-only">{{ description }}</DialogDescription>
      <Command class="rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent">
        <slot />
      </Command>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { CommandGroup as SdkCommandGroup, CommandGroupLabel } from '@ui-sdk/vue/command'
import { provideCommandGroupContext, useCommandContext } from './context'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type CommandGroupProps = {
  heading?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<CommandGroupProps>(), {
  heading: undefined,
})

const context = useCommandContext()
const groupIds = reactive(new Set<string>())

provideCommandGroupContext({
  registerGroupItem: (id) => {
    groupIds.add(id)
  },
  unregisterGroupItem: (id) => {
    groupIds.delete(id)
  },
})

const isVisible = computed(() => {
  if (context.filterDisabled.value || context.search.value.trim() === '') return true
  if (groupIds.size === 0) return false
  for (const id of groupIds) {
    if (context.visibleIds.value.has(id)) return true
  }
  return false
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkCommandGroup
    v-show="isVisible"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('overflow-hidden text-ink [&+&]:mt-1', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <CommandGroupLabel
      v-if="heading || $slots.heading"
      class="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-ink-faint"
    >
      <slot name="heading">{{ heading }}</slot>
    </CommandGroupLabel>
    <slot />
  </SdkCommandGroup>
</template>
